scenes.name: Beach
scenes.description: Explore the beach, talk about weather, and ask a lifeguard for safe fun.

scenes.name: Farm
scenes.description: Meet a farmer, name animals and foods, and talk about simple farm jobs.

scenes.name: Home
scenes.description: Practice warm family English at home: rooms, chores, and polite help.

scenes.name: Park
scenes.description: Play in a sunny park, invite a friend, and talk about outdoor activities.

scenes.name: Restaurant
scenes.description: A cozy restaurant where you can order food from a friendly waiter.

scenes.name: School
scenes.description: Practice classroom English with a teacher and ask about school supplies.

scenes.name: Shop
scenes.description: Buy snacks and toys from a cheerful shopkeeper using polite money English.

scenes.name: Zoo
scenes.description: Meet a zookeeper and talk about animals, colors, and simple directions.

scenes.name: Airport
scenes.description: Check in for a flight, ask for a boarding pass, and find the gate.

scenes.name: Hospital
scenes.description: Visit a friendly clinic, explain how you feel, and learn caring health English.

scenes.name: Hotel
scenes.description: Check in at a hotel, ask for a room, and practice polite travel English.
